items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I had a call from Frank de Vol. He said, "You've got to go do this date with me." I said, "Of course!" I liked working with him anyhow.

ctx.x: Ponda's show. Do you remember that? He played a policeman, and they happened to live on Primrose Lane. So the opening shot was of Primrose Lane, and they played my song which was named "Primrose Lane" as the theme of the show. And the funny way that happened, I had a call from Frank de Vol. He said, "You've got to go do this date with me." I said, "Of course!" I liked working with him anyhow. He's one of the nice people I know. Out of the many nice people, he's one of the very nicest. Anyhow, I get in the studio,…
